methods.name: Image correlation techniques
methods.summary: The method uses a combination of optical (Pléiades) and SAR (Sentinel-1) image correlation to detect and monitor slow-moving landslides. It involves DEM construction, orthorectification, image correlation using Mic-Mac and a custom SAR correlation tool, and time-inversion of displacement fields using the TIO software.
methods.source: Authors' own development (using Mic-Mac, TIO, and custom SAR correlation tool)
methods.verbatim: The tool also provides a chain of workflows that co-register and compute the displacements from time series of images (https://effidir.poleterresolide.fr/index.php/effidir-tools).
